"""Pin and take custody of this fresh QA staging directory, then stage once."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
root = Path('/tmp/forge-release-e49e149')
assert root.resolve() == root and root.is_dir()
pins = {
    'release.json': '2825d469a78a8126e14bc71d6d592c49abb73f2c117088e8a80bc358a1936404',
    'controls.tar': '3df9714377da9bf3a020d30b04cfdc0e49de7556e25f8fcc7a174ee4b6a48857',
    'stage-controls.py': 'ed99b2f7bbfacb934092a733aaecf7c182c472b4ad93754a3e2171f847fced86',
    'native-control.py': '71681f97c371a8818bc48992f20c4119fc6969548923140966a7865c8cf81dda',
    'capture-probe.py': '6b6178ec1d5e5cc2911919794d433254554e46fcd51e79a4504c6f2b50603379',
    'observer-selftest.py': 'bb07d34a63f2538c985c213e7ea3d6d39cd75777db276e63ac858018573bd526',
    'observer-helper.py': 'df957d4ae64990047f7a82581c3d3324cba6b3c3e5c8402947d5915c20197929',
}
assert {p.name for p in root.iterdir()} == set(pins)
for name, pin in pins.items():
    path = root / name
    assert path.resolve() == path and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pin
os.chown(root, 0, 0)
root.chmod(0o700)
for name in pins:
    path = root / name
    os.chown(path, 0, 0)
    path.chmod(0o600)
proxy = Path('/tmp/forge-release-88214ba/native-proxy.py')
assert proxy.resolve() == proxy and proxy.stat().st_uid == 0 and not proxy.stat().st_mode & 0o022
raw = proxy.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == 'd0be9fb2cdc6a2da032dee4f73775400c78f66a1afd67d768063e6931dcb57c4'
with (root / 'native-proxy.py').open('xb') as stream:
    stream.write(raw)
(root / 'native-proxy.py').chmod(0o600)
with (root / 'stage-intent.json').open('x') as stream:
    json.dump({'pins': pins, 'serving_mutation': False, 'attempts': 1}, stream, sort_keys=True)
    stream.flush()
    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3', str(root / 'stage-controls.py'), pins['release.json'], pins['controls.tar']], capture_output=True, timeout=660)
(root / 'stage.stdout').write_bytes(result.stdout)
(root / 'stage.private.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr)
assert result.returncode == 0, 'Staging failed; retain and reconcile partial root before any retry'
print(result.stdout.decode(), end='')
